content: हव्य {%a.%} [ह-कर्मणि यत्] To be offered in oblations. .{@-व्यम्@} .²1 Clarified butter. .²2 An oblation or offering to the gods (<ab>opp.</ab> कव्य <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²3 An oblation in general; ममेष्टं नित्यशो हव्यैर्मन्त्रैः संपूज्य पावकम् <ls>Rām. 7. 30. 12</ls>. .{@-व्या@} A cow; इडे रन्ते हव्ये <ab>etc.</ab> <ls>ŚB. on MS. 3. 10. 49</ls>.
